s: Specialized time-series database with built-in retention, downsampling, and windowed math.
w: TSM trees optimize timestamp-ordered writes/compactions. Retention policies auto-expire raw data; tasks downsample into summary measurements (5m averages). Flux/InfluxQL express time-window aggregations naturally. Cardinality (unique tag combos) is THE scaling constraint.
use: Industrial sensor fleets with straightforward tag models
Fast prototyping of TS apps before bespoke choices needed
avoid: Long-term archival (pair with object storage tiers)
pits: Cardinality explosion from unbounded tags (uuid tags!) - whitelist label values
tips: Cardinality concept is the interview differentiator vs other TSDBs
